traditional: 由 A 至 B，頭尾都計
jyutping: jau4 A zi3 B tau4 mei5 dou1 gai3

english.note: Use this specifically for a range where both endpoints are included.

examples.english: This shop is open from Monday to Friday, inclusive.
examples.traditional: 呢間舖星期一至星期五，頭尾都計，都會開門。
examples.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 pou3 sing1 kei4 jat1 zi3 sing1 kei4 ng5 tau4 mei5 dou1 gai3 dou1 wui5 hoi1 mun4
